criteria.add_itinerary_item: add an activity to a trip day
criteria.add_trip_stop: add a stop to the route
criteria.reorder_trip_stops: change the order of the stops
criteria.add_stay: record where we sleep and which nights
criteria.attach_trip_list: attach a list, like packing, to a trip

criteria.add_person: add a person Bobby should know
criteria.record_fact: remember a fact about a thing
criteria.where_is: where a sharing member is now

criteria.get_location: use the shared location or home address
criteria.request_current_location: ask the person to share their location
criteria.geocode: look up where a place is
criteria.member_distance: how far a member is by saved address
criteria.distance_from_home: how far a place is from home

criteria.read_file: read a file uploaded to this chat

criteria.media_add: add a movie or show to the watch list
criteria.media_check: check again where a title streams
